en.name: DC 421 PBS - Double Head Mitre Saw Machine (Full Automatic)
en.description: DC 421 PBS is a fully automatic sawing machine that is designed for the strait or angular cutting operations of large size of profiles made of PVC and aluminium materials by means of double head sawing units equipped with Ø 420 mm of saw blades

STANDARD ACCESSORIES: 2 x Ø 420 mm of saw blade
Roller conveyor & 2 x pneumatic profile supports
OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES: DKN 80 arrow cut system for mullion profiles
Machine with the length of 5 m
Machine with the length of 6 m
GENERAL FEATURES: Tilting automatically to 90° and 45° inwards for both angles. Manual adjustment of other intermediate angles from 90° to 45° inwards
Solid steel construction of the body
Windows based industrial PC and 15’’ LCD touch screen colour monitor
Facility to transfer the cutting list in ‘mdb’ and ‘csv’ format via USB and network
Obtains profile cutting dimensions and angles from the cut list while working in automatic mode
Technical support via remote connection capability
The power of sawing motors: 2 pcs. X 2.2 kW

technical_data.Saw Diameter: D: Ø420 mm / d: Ø30-32 mm
